# Tracker

> Multi-agent LLM pipeline orchestration with hard cost ceilings, parallel branches in git worktrees, and a live TUI. Define workflows in a small text file (`.dip`); every run is a git commit you can diff and replay. Built by 2389.ai.

## Quickstart

- Install: `brew install 2389-research/tap/tracker` (or `go install github.com/2389-research/tracker/cmd/tracker@latest`).
- In a git repo: `tracker explain --param question="what does this repo do?"` — read-only answer, saved to `.tracker/runs/<run-id>/explain.md`.
- Then: `tracker quickfix --param change="<one sentence>"` — one change in a worktree on `tracker/quickfix/<run-id>`, tests run, review gate approve / revise / reject; nothing is merged or pushed.
- From an agent or CI (no terminal): a human gate pauses the run (exit 4) and prints the gate; answer with `tracker answer <run-id> <label>` (or `--text`, `--default`) to resume. `tracker answer` lists waiting runs.
- No API key needed with Claude Code installed and signed in (`backend: auto`); otherwise `tracker setup`. Pin a specific `claude` with `TRACKER_CLAUDE_BIN` (shell only). Problems: `tracker doctor`, `tracker diagnose`.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/): What tracker is and how to install + run it in 60 seconds.
- [Workflows](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/workflows.html): Six built-in pipelines — the `explain` and `quickfix` starters (★ start here), `ask_and_execute`, `build_product`, `build_product_with_superspec`, `deep_review` — and how `.dip` files are structured.
- [Architecture](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/architecture.html): Engine, nodes, edges, backends (native / Claude Code / ACP), checkpoints, parallel execution, budget governance.
- [CLI Reference](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/cli.html): Every flag and subcommand — `run`, `setup`, `validate`, `simulate`, `estimate`, `doctor`, `diagnose`, `audit` (alias `list`), `status`, `answer`, `init`, `workflows` (starters first), `verify-tests`, `update`, `version` — and every environment variable.
- [Changelog](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/changelog.html): Release history with breaking changes and feature notes.
- [Glossary](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/glossary.html): Terminology used across the docs and `.dip` files.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/2389-research/tracker): Source code, issue tracker, and tagged releases.
- [AGENTS.md](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/AGENTS.md): Agent-readable orientation for this site.
- [sitemap.xml](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable URL index.
- [sitemap.md](https://2389-research.github.io/tracker/sitemap.md): Human-readable URL index.
